meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: When to delegate to `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit) or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of working inline or using `Explore`. Their output is compressed, so main context lasts longer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需分派子代理处理代码定位、修改与审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想通过子代理分工节省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate to sub-agents for code search, edits, and reviews to save context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI and want to manage context by delegating tasks to sub-agents.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会把三类任务转交给专门的子代理：查找代码定义/调用、做 1~2 个文件的局部修改、审查 diff 以找出问题。这些子代理返回的是压缩且带文件行号的简要结果，比普通回复占用的对话记忆更少。
howto.when: 当用户询问某个符号在哪定义或被谁调用，或要求小范围修改某个文件，或要检查最近改动里的错误时，Claude 就可能调用该技能对应的子代理。

say.text: 函数 `foo` 定义在哪个文件？哪些地方调用了它？
say.note: 会触发 investigator 去定位并返回带行号的清单。

say.text: 帮我审查刚才的 diff，有没有潜在 bug？
say.note: 会触发 reviewer 给出按严重级别的发现列表。

howto.what_en: Installing this adds three subagent presets: locate code, edit 1-2 files, review diffs. They return compressed, path/line-anchored findings, using less main-context than vanilla tools.
howto.when_en: Fires when you ask to locate code (defs/callers), make a small 1-2 file edit, or check a diff for bugs; Claude delegates to the matching subagent.

say_en.text: Where is `foo` defined and who calls it?
say_en.note: Sends to investigator for path:line results.

say_en.text: In src/util.ts line 20, change default from true to false. Only that file.
say_en.note: Builder performs the edit and returns verification.

say_en.text: Check my last diff for bugs.
